# Luxembourg

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 67% | 100% (estimate, medium confidence, 85.9–100.0%) | not applicable | 0% |

Broad but shallow: lexifina/luxembourg-law holds the revised 2023 Constitution with its full history (39 versions, to the Art. 15 revision in force 2026-08-29), plus 6,884 laws Legilux marks in force, one commit each, and 6,406 of those are the text as first published. Code civil, Code pénal, Code de commerce and Code du travail are current consolidated texts. The Nouveau Code de procédure civile, the Code de procédure pénale and all case law are missing, and 45 in-force dates are impossible (including one copied as 0001-01-01 from Legilux's own metadata).

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
